items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: But of course the guys used to say you know, Freddie wouldn’t let you — not Jo Jones, he was wonderful.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean it just added that extra bit to the rhythm section.

It added a bit of something musical. You know, the chords, and the strings. I was thinking just the other day, Stanley was playing something very good, and I thought, what a pity they were so smart as to mix out the guitar. Because it was a wonderful rhythm instrument. And of course the guys used to say you know, Freddie wouldn’t let you — not Jo Jones, he was wonderful. But they used to say Freddie wouldn’t let you budge from the beat. Freddie was immovable from the beat, which was really quite wonderful. But…
